summary: Registered a successor execution for the first boundary case the account leaves open: a further election after the healed partition. The harness now shuts down whichever instance led the healed cluster, waits two election windows, and emits an applied_state_after_election event with the resulting leader count, the lowest index at which the restarted side's and the first peer's stores still hold differing entries, both sides' applied positions, and a derived divergent_applied_after_election field - so whether a later term reconciles the divergent committed content is observed rather than assumed. Compilation verified locally (go vet clean on a copy of the captured tree with the updated harness); the earlier phases are unchanged and were already executed in receipt 8c866b71bf0e470e900a15e895b2bed9. The comparison set carries the six recorded predicates (healing convergence, surviving entries, applied divergence with its control, the continuation predicate) plus the new post-election predicate for the flag-enabled case and its flag-disabled control. Submission validated (valid true, execution requested): one experiment created. Note that a bounded-completed stop request was rejected earlier, so the audit stays open and the remaining boundary cases are the fault and storage model ones - a disk-backed commit-tracking store, crash and restart timing, and a post-healing snapshot transfer.
